festivals.name: CRSSD Festival — Fall 2026
festivals.why: SD is a drive, but this is festival-tier and on-taste — Disclosure, Chris Lake, Groove Armada (DJ set), Helena Hauff, Ben UFO, I Hate Models, Mathame, Carlita, salute. House/ techno/melodic, European lean, waterfront, 21+. NOTE: same weekend as Portola (SF) — can't do both; pick one.

festivals.name: Portola 2026
festivals.why: THE one for you — electronic-forward with DESPACIO (James Murphy + 2ManyDJs sound system), Four Tet, Soulwax, Groove Armada, DJ Shadow, Fatboy Slim, Skepta, plus Robyn, Tiësto, Swedish House Mafia. European/house energy in a warehouse-pier setting. 2-day ~$380.

festivals.name: Coachella 2027
festivals.why: Advance GA already sold out (~$549–599); official lineup not yet announced. Industry trades (Hits Daily Double) rumor Tame Impala + Dua Lipa headlining with Fred again.. in the "Returning to the Desert" slot — unconfirmed, ~7 months out.

festivals.name: GALA Festival (London) — 2027 edition
festivals.why: Quintessential European house/disco day-fest (2026: Seth Troxler, Todd Terje, Call Super, DJ Seinfeld). On-taste, but not timely — only bubble up when 2027 presale/lineup drops.

dining.name: Mírate
dining.notes: Multi-level rooftop, Tulum-jungle candlelight; bar voted Best in California. Strong chic/date-night + birthday pick. Eastside.

dining.name: Wilde's
dining.notes: Tiny candlelit British bistro/wine bar; bakery-cafe by day. Intimate date-night; tables hard — Notify/bar seats. Eastside.

dining.name: Cafe Stella
dining.notes: Reopened after 2024 closure; slimmed menu — steak au poivre, frisée, frozen-lemon sorbet. Sunset Junction, home turf.

dining.name: Rasarumah
dining.notes: Eastside hotspot (Variety also flagged it). Confirm exact address/neighborhood next pass.

dining.name: Dunsmoor
dining.notes: Restored 1920s building around a huge wood-burning hearth. Eastside, on-profile for a special night.

dining.name: Yess
dining.notes: Grew out of the Yess Aquatic seafood truck. Chef Junya Yamasaki — confirm details next pass.

dining.name: Sushi Nakazawa
dining.notes: Omakase from a Jiro Ono protégé; NYC import's LA debut. Neighborhood unconfirmed.

dining.name: Hermon's
dining.notes: Refreshed chophouse from the Found Oyster team — martinis, pull-apart garlic bread, pasta vongole. Confirm neighborhood.

dining.name: Mish
dining.notes: New-wave deli on La Brea — wood-fired bagels, shakshuka with challah, pastrami reuben on schmaltz-griddled rye.

dining.name: Asadero
dining.notes: Above-average taco stand — smoky asada from a chef who left corporate kitchens. Confirm neighborhood.

dining.name: Amiguita
dining.notes: On the Resy Hit List; details unconfirmed — fill in cuisine/neighborhood next pass.

dining.name: Pasjoli
dining.notes: Refined French bistro, Chef Dave Beran (ex-Alinea). Westside — special-occasion, not walkable.

dining.name: Kassi
dining.notes: Greek-Med rooftop in Venice — mezze, lamb chops, grilled whole fish. Westside.

dining.name: San Laurel
dining.notes: Spanish-inflected dining high in the InterContinental DTLA (José Andrés group).

dining.name: Calabra
dining.notes: Mediterranean rooftop atop the Santa Monica Proper — charred flatbreads, mezze, grilled fish.

dining.name: Found Oyster
dining.notes: Tiny, buzzy seafood bar — clam cakes, chicken-fried oysters. Walk-in/bar; parent of Hermon's. Home turf.

dining.name: Bar Restaurant
dining.notes: Pink-hued, 'strange and fantastic' modern French. Intimate date-night; books up. Sunset Junction, walkable.

dining.name: Sogo Roll Bar
dining.notes: Handroll bar from the Sushi Note team — creative, high-quality fish. Counter seats. Eastside.

dining.name: Lolo Wine Bar
dining.notes: Low-key neighborhood wine bar with a great patio + shareable pasta. Walkable from home.

dining.name: Marco Polo
dining.notes: Outdoor-focused Italian — linguini vongole, gin-arugula cocktails. Patio date-night. Home turf.

dining.name: Clark Street Bakery
dining.notes: Echo Park bakery — caramelized kouign-amann, Nordic breakfast platters. Daytime/casual.

dining.name: Kismet Rotisserie
dining.notes: Casual rotisserie next to Kismet — roast chicken on pita, veg sides. Easy weeknight. Eastside.

dining.name: Jeff's Table
dining.notes: Cult deli hidden behind a liquor store — pastrami, specialty turkey. Lunch. Eastside.

dining.name: Yang's Kitchen
dining.notes: Order-at-counter Taiwanese-Chinese — braised pork rice, beef scallion wraps. SGV-adjacent.

dining.name: Sonmari
dining.notes: Silver Lake handroll spot — inventive DIY rolls (gochujang eel, 'banh mi' albacore). Walkable.

dining.name: Bar Di Bello
dining.notes: Low-lit Milanese-style aperitivo bar — cutlets, branzino, antipasti. Date-night. Home turf.

dining.name: Holbox
dining.notes: Game-changing Mexican seafood stall in Mercado La Paloma — aguachiles, tostadas. Michelin Bib-tier value (confirm). Walk-up.

dining.name: Quarter Sheets
dining.notes: Thick pan-style pizza + great wine list. Bib Gourmand value. Echo Park — walkable from home.

dining.name: Pizzeria Bianco
dining.notes: Chris Bianco's LA outpost (Row DTLA) — among the country's best pizza. Bib Gourmand. Confirm exact address.

dining.name: Sushi Note
dining.notes: Sushi-and-wine bar (team behind Sogo Roll Bar). Valley — a destination, not walkable.

dining.name: Santo
dining.notes: Japanese-Mexican nigiri/handrolls + sake & wine, Sunset Junction. Home turf; next to Bar Seco. (Santō)

dining.name: Bar Seco
dining.notes: Natural wine bar + small plates (CDMX/Madrid/Japan), spills onto Sunset. Walk-in/sidewalk seats. Next to Santo. (aka Seco)

dining.name: Superba
dining.notes: ARI'S ABSOLUTE FAVORITE — food + ambiance, the patio especially (also great inside). Superba Food + Bread, Lincoln Blvd. Westside — worth the drive.

dining.name: L&E Oyster Bar
dining.notes: Silver Lake oyster bar; the upstairs bar is the chill walk-in move. Home turf.

dining.name: Pijja Palace
dining.notes: Indian-Italian sports bar — pizza, pasta, cricket on the TVs. Very popular (hard rez / walk-in bar). Silver Lake, home turf.

dining.name: Night + Market Song
dining.notes: Kris Yenbamroong's fiery northern Thai on Sunset. Walk-in friendly. Home turf.

dining.name: Momed
dining.notes: Mediterranean — mezze, wraps, bowls. Atwater Village (also Beverly Hills). Eastside, easy.

dining.name: Bar Siesta
dining.notes: New Spanish tapas + all-Spanish wine bar (Heather Sperling team). On-taste wine bar, home turf.

dining.name: Atrium
dining.notes: Playful, vaguely-French cooking from Douglas Rankin in the old Malo space, Sunset Junction. New. Home turf.

dining.name: Bowery Bungalow
dining.notes: Modern Mediterranean from George Abou-Daoud in the former Sompun Thai. New, home turf.

dining.name: Frank n Franks
dining.notes: Sandwich spot from a Howlin' Ray's vet. Casual lunch, Chinatown — eastside-adjacent.

events.title: WORK OVER/TIME: JIA, MARRØN, NEKTER, Rene Wise, Rrose, Sarah Wreath [Live], & Wata Igarashi
events.detail: Each of these three artists have a distinct take on mind-bending, hypnotic techno. Come discover the genre's many shades at this extended afterhours session.
reasons: +4 event card (+2 draw, +1 rare booking, +1 stacked bill)

artist_notes.name: Rrose
artist_notes.note: US techno producer/performer known for hypnotic, physically intense techno (Eaux, Stroboscopic Artefacts orbit) — one of the more respected voices in abstract, mind-bending techno right now.

artist_notes.name: Wata Igarashi
artist_notes.note: Tokyo-based producer whose cerebral, psychedelic, hypnotic techno (Midgar Records) has made him a genuinely in-demand international touring name.

artist_notes.name: Marrøn
artist_notes.note: Jessey Voorn — Dutch/Surinamese DJ known for rhythmic, tribal-inflected techno pulling on African percussion; co-founder/resident of Amsterdam's EERSTE COMMUNIE.

artist_notes.name: Rene Wise
artist_notes.note: Brighton-born, Portugal-based DJ/producer (Mote-Evolver, his own Moving Pressure label) — hypnotic, groovy, rolling 90s-leaning techno; backed by Rødhad, Blawan and DVS1.

artist_notes.name: Sarah Wreath
artist_notes.note: Berlin-based sound artist and live techno producer — deep, psychedelic, hypnotic sets; debut LP 'Integration' on The Bunker New York, plus a Sandwell District collaboration.

artist_notes.name: JIA
artist_notes.note: Founder of 6AM Group and co-founder of LA's RE/FORM Festival — a connector/promoter as much as a DJ, with residencies at Factory 93 and Beyond Wonderland.

artist_notes.name: NEKTER
artist_notes.note: LA-based techno DJ, 2021 REFORM DJ Contest winner (6AM Group/Synthetik Minds) — resident at WORK LA, playing hypnotic, texture-heavy techno sets.

enrichment.curator_note: Rrose and Wata Igarashi alone are worth clearing a night for — two of the most respected names in hypnotic, physically-heavy techno right now — and stacking them with Marrøn's tribal groove plus the 6AM/WORK locals makes this the real deep-cut booking of the weekend, TBA location and marathon Friday-into-Sunday runtime included.
enrichment.description: An extended TBA-location afterhours techno session (Fri 11pm into Sunday morning) from 6AM Group and Synthetik Minds, headlined by Rrose and Wata Igarashi alongside Marrøn, Rene Wise, Sarah Wreath, JIA and NEKTER.

events.detail: GA 18+ Welcome w/ Valid ID VIP 21+ Welcome w/ Valid ID Doors: 8PM *All times and supporting acts are subject to change without notice Premier Parking vouchers are valid starting two (2) hours prior to doors opening for the event. Earlier on-site parking access is not guaranteed. Vinyl Room Doors open @ 6:30PM

artist_notes.name: Mesmé
artist_notes.note: LA DJ/producer (debut EP on Mall Grab's Steel City Dance Discs) — vinyl-heavy blends of moody acid, electro, house and trip-hop; Into the Woods and Dublab resident, Boiler Room 2021.

enrichment.curator_note: Overmono is a tracked name and this is a proper club date, not a festival slot — the Gawsworth brothers' rave-nostalgic breaks-and-melody sound (Fabric, Warp) translates well to the Palladium's room, with a dedicated Vinyl Room opening early at 6:30.
enrichment.description: UK duo Overmono's 'Pure Devotion' world tour stops at Hollywood Palladium, doors 8pm with a 6:30pm Vinyl Room opener.

events.title: club speed.star presents: RIRIA , Trekkie Trax Crew, Linda Lo, Avi Loud
events.detail: Tokyo-born, London-based RIRIA hits the LA underground with her sharp blend of UK garage, amapiano, Jersey club and dub.
reasons: +4 event card (+2 draw, +1 rare booking, +1 stacked bill)

artist_notes.name: RIRIA
artist_notes.note: Tokyo-born, London-based selector blending UK garage, amapiano, Jersey club and dub — her 2024 Boiler Room set hit ~5M views, Mixmag named her a 2025 Breakthrough DJ, and she's now a Rinse FM resident.

artist_notes.name: Trekkie Trax Crew
artist_notes.note: Tokyo collective (andrew, Carpainter, futatsuki, Seimei) behind the genre-agnostic Trekkie Trax label — house, techno, footwork and juke, with support from Ben UFO and Gilles Peterson.

enrichment.curator_note: RIRIA's the real get here — she's mid-breakout (that Boiler Room set, the Rinse residency) and this underground Club Catwalk booking with Tokyo's Trekkie Trax crew is a rowdier, more global-bass night than the usual house/techno rotation; the RA pick is earned.
enrichment.description: RA-pick club night: rising Tokyo/London selector RIRIA (UK garage, amapiano, Jersey club, dub) with Tokyo's Trekkie Trax Crew, Linda Lo and Avi Loud at Club Catwalk.

artist_notes.name: Daphni
artist_notes.note: Dan Snaith's (Caribou) dancefloor-focused alias, running his own Jiaolong label since 2012 — more raw and club-built than his Caribou records, with a strong Afro/global-rhythm bent.

enrichment.curator_note: Daphni isn't a side-project curiosity — it's Caribou's Dan Snaith building tracks specifically for a dancefloor, and he almost never plays full all-night sets; this is the rare chance to hear it stretched out instead of a festival hour.
enrichment.description: Wellness Check presents a full all-night set from Daphni, Dan Snaith's (Caribou) club-facing alias.

events.title: Stereo Punks presents Never Dull, Alastair Lane (US Debut), Seamus Haji
reasons: +4 event card (+2 draw, +1 rare booking, +1 stacked bill)

artist_notes.name: Seamus Haji
artist_notes.note: UK house veteran since the '80s, Big Love label boss and former Defected/Strictly Rhythm A&R — remixed everyone from Rihanna to Mariah Carey, held residencies at Pacha Ibiza and Ministry of Sound.

artist_notes.name: Alastair Lane
artist_notes.note: French house/indie-dance producer whose 'Roman d'Amour' went viral (a Top 40 most-Shazamed house track globally in 2024) — this show is billed as his US debut.

artist_notes.name: Never Dull
artist_notes.note: LA/Tijuana disco-house producer — a multi-year Traxsource top artist with co-signs from Disclosure, Dom Dolla and John Summit.

enrichment.curator_note: A real US-debut booking in Alastair Lane plus a genuine UK house lifer in Seamus Haji, open-air near the 6th St Bridge — a much stronger lineup than the generic 'Stereo Punks presents' title lets on.
enrichment.description: Open-air house/disco/UK garage night near the 6th St Bridge: Never Dull, US-debut Alastair Lane, and UK veteran Seamus Haji, 8pm-3am.

events.title: A Club Called Rhonda w/ DJ Minx, DJ Holographic, Anastazja, Colored Craig, Gay Felony, Goddollars
events.detail: House heads unite. This blockbuster lineup featuring some of the best DJs in the game will be a high-energy affair of funky grooves and deep, driving basslines.

artist_notes.name: DJ Minx
artist_notes.note: Detroit house matriarch, Women on Wax founder — deep, soulful, dancefloor-first selection; a tracked name.

artist_notes.name: DJ Holographic
artist_notes.note: Detroit DJ/producer (Ariel Corley) blending house, disco, Motown and techno — 2025 debut album 'House In The Dark' leans Afrofuturist; praised by Carl Craig and The Blessed Madonna, has played Panorama Bar and Smart Bar.

artist_notes.name: Anastazja
artist_notes.note: LA DJ (USC grad) who came up through Soulection Radio, played Boiler Room and recently supported Keinemusik's Rampa — a credential that tracks with the melodic/Keinemusik lane.

artist_notes.name: Colored Craig
artist_notes.note: LA DJ known for soul/funk/jack-leaning house sets — a regular guest at A Club Called Rhonda over the years.

artist_notes.name: Gay Felony
artist_notes.note: LA DJ/producer (Melody Scallion) — extended vinyl sets ranging from soulful/progressive house to hard house and melodic techno; hosts a Dublab radio show.

artist_notes.name: Goddollars
artist_notes.note: Loren Granich — Rhonda's own co-founder/resident, playing the sexy house-and-disco sound the party was built around.

artist_notes.name: A Club Called Rhonda
artist_notes.note: LA's own queer disco/house institution (Loren Granic & Gregory Alexander) — the closest thing on this bill to the rooftop-groove lane, all disco edits and drag-flecked chaos rather than a band.

enrichment.curator_note: A Club Called Rhonda built its name as one of LA's original queer-inclusive disco parties, and this booking leans into that history — DJ Minx headlining over a genuinely deep house/disco bench (DJ Holographic, Anastazja, Gay Felony, Colored Craig). Great party, just know the room it's playing to.
enrichment.description: A Club Called Rhonda's recurring Silver Lake disco night at Los Globos, headlined by Detroit house matriarch DJ Minx alongside DJ Holographic, Anastazja, Colored Craig, Gay Felony and Goddollars.

events.title: Latinas In The House: Juliet Mendoza, Spinorita, SEEPS, Abbylicious, R.O.B.I.N., Guaparda, Andy Oro
events.detail: Celebrate Hispanic Heritage Month with this special showcase of Latin American women in house music. The night begins with a panel discussion from Latina DJs and promoters.
reasons: +3 event card (+1 draw, +1 rare booking, +1 stacked bill)

artist_notes.name: Juliet Mendoza
artist_notes.note: LA-native house DJ and dancer — founder/resident of Jill's House (Jackin Jills), a Defected 'Unsung Heroes' alum; melodic, soulful, deep house rooted in the city's Black/Latin house dance lineage.

artist_notes.name: Spiñorita
artist_notes.note: Angela Ramirez — Alhambra-raised Chicana DJ and host of NTS's Casual Play; disco, house, funk and vinyl-digging roots, a fixture of LA's underground/backyard party scene since 2010.

artist_notes.name: SEEPS
artist_notes.note: Bronx-born, LA-based DJ steeped in NYC's '90s golden-era house and disco/boogie — has drawn attention from Louie Vega and DJ Sneak.

artist_notes.name: Guaparda
artist_notes.note: Estefanía Gallo-Gonzalez (aka Langosta) — LA-based singer, DJ and dublab radio host currently studying to be a music librarian/archivist; house-leaning selections, releases via the dottidot orbit.

artist_notes.name: Andy Oro
artist_notes.note: LA DJ, host of the Oro Hour on VPN Radio and a Made to Move resident — eclectic underground/house sets pulling from DIY dance music, hip-hop and bloghouse.

artist_notes.name: O B I
artist_notes.note: German hard-techno veteran of 20+ years, runs his own Definition of Hard Techno label — rough, industrial-edged hard techno, not the melodic/peak-time end.

enrichment.curator_note: Made to Move's women-DJ showcase back at the Airliner on the 25th — Spiñorita's NTS pedigree and Juliet Mendoza's Jill's House lineage make this a real digging crowd, not a themed flyer with filler names. Cheap, close, bar-scale — not a big night out, but an honest one.
enrichment.description: Made to Move's 'Latinas in the House' night at The Airliner (Lincoln Heights), spotlighting women DJs Juliet Mendoza, Spiñorita, SEEPS, Guaparda and Andy Oro across house, disco and funk selections (8pm-2am, free before 8:30).

artist_notes.name: Dance Spirit
artist_notes.note: LA duo (Christopher Mohn & Reagan Denius) on Get Physical, Crosstown Rebels and Bedrock — heavy-low-end, futuristic minimal/progressive house, deep in the Desert Hearts family.

artist_notes.name: Robotek Reagan
artist_notes.note: Reagan Denius's solo alias — literally one half of Dance Spirit, so this bill is really the duo playing twice under two names.

artist_notes.name: Jackson Englund
artist_notes.note: LA DJ/producer and Gari Safari co-founder who folds neo-soul, funk and jazz into house; released on Desert Hearts.

enrichment.curator_note: It's Dance Spirit's own free album launch for 'LUNATIC,' and the fun wrinkle is that Robotek Reagan (half of the duo) is billed as a separate solo set alongside them — real Get Physical/Crosstown Rebels-adjacent minimal house at a small DTLA bar, not a generic local bill.
enrichment.description: Free album launch for Dance Spirit's 'LUNATIC' at Bar Franca, with support from Robotek Reagan (Dance Spirit's own Reagan Denius) and Jackson Englund.

artist_notes.name: Wax Motif
artist_notes.note: Sydney-born, LA-based producer (Danny Chien) and a defining voice in G-house/bass house — releases on Confession, Mad Decent, Fool's Gold; big, filthy low-end over subtlety.

enrichment.curator_note: Wax Motif helped define the modern G-house sound and still tours real rooms on the strength of it — this is a big, bass-forward night at Exchange, not a groove-and-disco one, so go in wanting drops rather than a deep selector set.
enrichment.description: Bass house and G-house producer Wax Motif headlines a late-night set at Exchange LA.

events.detail: Queer club crew Herrensauna return to DTLA for their third collaboration with local promoter TUNNEL. Get a taste of the real Berlin underground.

artist_notes.name: OZA
artist_notes.note: Brooklyn-born, LA-based DJ/producer and TUNNEL founder — high-energy sets blending hard house, breaks and techno; the promoter as much as the performer here.

enrichment.description: Hard techno and electro all-night set with MCMLXXXV, CEM, SALOME, OZA and Sevyn 0000 (11pm–6am, TBA location, $35–$45).

events.title: Gene On Earth, Momo Trosman, Cromie, Chemtrail Johnny, Hazy, Ian Llorens, Gilbert0

artist_notes.name: Momo Trosman
artist_notes.note: Buenos Aires-born DJ/producer, DJing professionally since 2011 with European tours behind him — dub- and jazz-informed digging across UK/US house, electro and techno; co-runs the Cure Music label.

artist_notes.name: Cromie
artist_notes.note: Zagreb-born, LA-based producer — Balearic-fringe house: crisp grooves, warm melodies and hazy breaks, released via Amadeus Records and Duality Trax.

artist_notes.name: Gene On Earth
artist_notes.note: San Francisco-born, Berlin-based DJ/producer (Eugene Albert) — runs the Limousine Dream label; deep-digging extended sets drifting through minimal house, breaks and hazy late-night rollers.

artist_notes.name: Chemtrail Johnny
artist_notes.note: SoCal DJ/producer working in minimal, laid-back house and techno grooves — low profile but a real local scene name.

artist_notes.name: Hazy
artist_notes.note: Recurring Sunday Sessions LA resident — vinyl-only house sets, a regular on the rotation at the series' open-airs.

artist_notes.name: Ian Llorens
artist_notes.note: Certified Groovers resident, LA-based (Puerto Rico-born) — rhythm-forward house/techno selector, also plays as O God / Soundprism.

artist_notes.name: Gilbert0
artist_notes.note: Another Certified Groovers regular — same all-vinyl deep-house lane, secret-location DTLA parties.

enrichment.curator_note: This is the TBA-warehouse afterhours format Ari already likes, and the lineup is a notch deeper than most of them — Momo Trosman and Cromie are legit diggers, not just names filling a flyer.
enrichment.description: TBA-location DTLA afterhours (10pm-8am) with tech-house/breaks selectors Gene On Earth, Momo Trosman, Cromie, Chemtrail Johnny, Hazy, Ian Llorens and Gilbert0.

artist_notes.note: Zurich-born, Berlin-based (longtime Watergate resident) house producer now signed to Innervisions — jazzy, soulful, musician's-ear house that broke through via 2014's Defected hit 'Pushing On.'

reasons: +4 event card (+2 draw, +1 rare booking, +1 stacked bill)

artist_notes.name: Jen Cardini
artist_notes.note: Jennifer Cardini — French-born, Berlin-based house/techno DJ, 30 years in, founder of the Correspondant label (grew out of her Rex Club Paris residency, now Kompakt-distributed) spanning deep house, Italo, cosmic disco and techno.

artist_notes.name: Konduku
artist_notes.note: Ruben Üvez — Dutch producer based in Berlin, releases on Nous'klaer Audio and Delsin — hypnotic, detail-heavy techno with a UK bass-culture streak; a selector's selector, not a big-room name.

artist_notes.name: Buttechno
artist_notes.note: Pavel Milyakov — Moscow underground fixture (John's Kingdom collective, tight with Gost Zvuk and Klasse Wrecks) making spacious, dystopian techno; this is a live set, not a DJ set.

enrichment.curator_note: This is the real deal — Jen Cardini's Correspondant/Rex Club pedigree, Buttechno bringing his raw Moscow techno live, and Konduku's hypnotic, UK-bass-inflected style, all in a TBA DTLA warehouse running to 5am. About as close to a proper European club night as LA gets.

artist_notes.name: RAVEDAD
artist_notes.note: LA underground DJ (Maggie Baron), Dublab regular and co-founder of the 90s-throwback afterhours series Serenity Rave.

artist_notes.note: LA experimental-beat producer from the Low End Theory/Brainfeeder-adjacent 2000s beat scene — glitchy, genre-blurring sets, a real veteran name for anyone into that lineage.

artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ and radio host known for genre-blending, eclectic sets rather than a single lane — less pedigree info available, so treat as the wildcard on this bill.

artist_notes.name: SG Lewis
artist_notes.note: British DJ/producer/songwriter — warm, disco-etched dance-pop (albums 'times', 'AudioLust & HigherLove'); has written and produced with Dua Lipa, Robyn and Nile Rodgers.

artist_notes.name: Hot Chip
artist_notes.note: Long-running London electronic band (since 2000, early DFA ties) — dance-rock/electropop ('Over and Over,' 'Ready For The Floor') with a big, festival-tested live show.

artist_notes.note: Harlem-raised, NYC-based DJ/producer blending hip-hop with dance/house — DJ'd Beyoncé's 'Homecoming' Coachella sets and played Boiler Room NYC.

artist_notes.note: LA-via-Miami producer/DJ (Stefania Aronin) — acid house and indie-dance with a punky, off-kilter edge; Dirtybird signee and Lights Down Low resident who runs the label Mi Domina.

events.genre: house, tech house, hard techno, trance
reasons: +4 event card (+3 draw, +1 rare booking, +1 stacked bill)

artist_notes.name: Kenny Dope
artist_notes.note: One half of the legendary Masters at Work (with Louie Vega) — 30+ years deep into foundational NYC house; the single most significant name on this bill.

artist_notes.name: Floorplan
artist_notes.note: Robert Hood & daughter Lyric Hood — Detroit techno royalty (M-Plant) turned deep, gospel-inflected house. 'Baby Baby' fills a floor for a reason.

artist_notes.name: HoneyLuv
artist_notes.note: Cleveland-born, ex-Navy — one of the biggest tech-house breakouts of the last few years; soulful, groovy end of the genre, runs her own 4 Tha Luv label.

artist_notes.name: Kitty Amor
artist_notes.note: London-based Afro house DJ, Get Physical/Mahaba Music — founded Motherland, an Afro house platform/collective; regular at Hi Ibiza and Grow London.

artist_notes.name: canary yellow
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ/producer (Denver-raised), a fixture of the local club scene — house and club-edit tracks out on Traxsource.

artist_notes.name: Faster Horses
artist_notes.note: UK (Manchester) DJ Joe Germains, describes his sound as trance/techno/psychedelia — plays for the Teletech and Interplanetary Criminal party circuits; releases on Euromantic and RAW.

artist_notes.name: Azyr / Shankz / STARRZA / TDJ / Natte Visstick / Desa Deca / EMILIJA
artist_notes.note: The extended Teletech crew Faster Horses reps (the Manchester-born hard/fast-techno collective now touring globally) filling out the bill — couldn't verify individual bios beyond that co-billing, so treat this stretch as a wildcard.

artist_notes.name: Coco & Breezy
artist_notes.note: Twin sisters (also the eyewear-brand founders) turned house/dance DJ duo — danceable, R&B-tinged, more crossover-pop energy than underground.

artist_notes.name: Hannah Laing
artist_notes.note: Dundee DJ, ex-dental technician turned fast-rising UK name — high-energy trance and hard house, runs the doof label and just launched her own festival.

artist_notes.name: STRAWBRY
artist_notes.note: LA underground fixture (South Florida-raised) — breaks-and-house sets, runs the STUDIO5400 party series.

artist_notes.name: Vieze Asbak
artist_notes.note: Dutch 'memecore'/troll-rave artist out of Amsterdam's Pestcore Collectief — hard-dance-adjacent chaos, not clean house or techno. A sign this bill gets weird in spots.

artist_notes.name: Jazzy (IRL)
artist_notes.note: Couldn't pin down a confident bio for this one — flagging as unverified rather than guessing.

enrichment.curator_note: This has grown into one of the more scattershot bills on the radar since it was first booked — Kenny Dope's actual Masters at Work pedigree, Robert Hood's gospel-house Floorplan, HoneyLuv's tech-house heat, Skepta stepping behind the decks, Kitty Amor's Afro house, LA's own canary yellow, and a chunk of Manchester's hard/fast Teletech crew all sharing stages at El Pueblo — expect real swings in sound depending which stage you're standing at, not one coherent vibe.
enrichment.description: Multi-stage Boiler Room Sunday day party at El Pueblo Historic Monument spanning Kenny Dope, Floorplan, HoneyLuv, Skepta's DJ set, Kitty Amor's Afro house, canary yellow and Manchester's Teletech crew.

events.detail: The winner of four 2024 Tony Awards®, including Best Musical, is THE OUTSIDERS.Adapted from S.E. Entertainment Weekly says, "THE OUTSIDERS has the power to inspire an entire generation."In Tulsa, Oklahoma, 1967, Ponyboy Curtis, his best friend Johnny Cade and their Greaser family of ‘outsiders’ battle with their affluent rivals, the Socs. THE OUTSIDERS navigates the complexities of self- discovery as the Greasers dream about who they want to become in a world that may never accept them. With a dynamic original score, THE OUTSIDERS is a story of friendship, family, belonging…and the realization that there is still “lots of good in the world.”

artist_notes.note: Curitiba-raised, Milan-based Brazilian selector and Toy Tonics artist ('Brasiliana EP') — 15+ years digging, playing disco/house sets rooted in Brazilian rhythm and global crate-digging.

artist_notes.name: DJ Godfather
artist_notes.note: Brian Jeffries — Detroit ghettotech founding father, co-founded Twilight 76 and Databass Records in the mid-'90s fusing Detroit techno with Miami bass. This is bass/electro turf, not the house-techno core lane, but he's the real deal in it.

artist_notes.name: BAE BAE
artist_notes.note: Kumi James — LA-born DJ/producer, sound artist, Planet Mu signee, and co-founder of Hood Rave (DTLA's queer-Black underground party). Sets weave footwork, juke, breaks and R&B through an explicitly Black-diasporic and femme lens; NTS and Dublab radio host.

artist_notes.name: SYMØNNE
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ/producer and founder of Blaque María, an all-woman/queer/BIPOC-centered collective and event brand; started in Boston/Bay Area underground circuits (Burning Man mainstage support) before relocating to LA. Sound leans Chicago house, tech-house, minimal and melodic techno — closer to the taste lane than her ghettotech billmates here.

enrichment.curator_note: This is a detour from the usual rooftop-house lane — Godfather is Detroit ghettotech royalty, all bass and 909 electro, not deep/disco. Worth it if you want a real TBA-warehouse afterhours with actual genre history behind the headliner rather than a generic late-night DJ booking.

artist_notes.name: SHERELLE
artist_notes.note: London 160bpm force spinning footwork, jungle and dnb — co-founded Hooversound and runs the Black/queer-focused label Beautiful; a fabric/Boiler Room-tier name, not a house purist but a real international draw.

artist_notes.name: Danny Daze
artist_notes.note: Miami techno/house producer on Omnidisc and Crosstown Rebels — respected selector on the US underground club circuit.

artist_notes.name: Mia Koden
artist_notes.note: South London producer/DJ, half of Sicaria Sound, working the 140bpm dub/garage/steppers space — released on Ilian Tape, RA's 2024 Breakthrough Artist.

artist_notes.name: Todd Edwards
artist_notes.note: New Jersey UK-garage legend ('God of Garage') who shaped Daft Punk's sound — chopped-vocal, skippy house.

artist_notes.name: bahar khadem
artist_notes.note: LA selector behind the Direct Drive party series — a self-described 'Chicago soul' deep house/club-music digger who's shared bills with Ariel Zetina and Introspekt on the DTLA warehouse circuit.

enrichment.curator_note: SHERELLE at 160bpm next to Todd Edwards' skippy garage and Pangaea's bass-techno makes this a genuinely eclectic booking, closer to a UK festival stage than an average Silver Lake house night.
enrichment.description: UK dnb force SHERELLE headlines a stacked house/techno/garage bill with Todd Edwards, Pangaea, Danny Daze and Mia Koden at Los Globos, 10pm-4am.

events.title: CSW Open Air: DjRUM [4hr], Mark Ernestus [3hr], Akanbi b2b The Large [Double set]
events.genre: techno, breaks, drum and bass, IDM, bass music, amapiano
reasons: +4 event card (+2 draw, +2 rare booking, +1 stacked bill)

artist_notes.name: DjRUM
artist_notes.note: Felix Manuel, London — jazz-trained producer/DJ (R&S, Ilian Tape) whose all-vinyl, three-turntable sets weave techno, breaks, jungle and ambient into something narrative rather than functional. A genuinely rare, extended (4hr) booking, not a standard tour stop.

artist_notes.name: Mark Ernestus
artist_notes.note: Berlin legend — founder of the Hard Wax record shop and one half of Basic Channel/Rhythm & Sound, the duo who invented dub techno. Now runs Ndagga Rhythm Force, fusing that lineage with Senegalese mbalax. A living-history booking that almost never comes through LA; his 3-hour set alone justifies the day.

artist_notes.name: Akanbi
artist_notes.note: Lagos-raised, NY-based DJ (GROOVY GROOVY founder) known for blending tough club rhythms into amapiano and Afro-adjacent sounds before hard turns into techno — the amapiano/bass-music strand on this bill.

artist_notes.name: The Large
artist_notes.note: NYC-scene selector, regularly paired with Akanbi (GROOVY GROOVY, Brooklyn) on amapiano/dancehall/afrobeats-leaning closing sets.

enrichment.curator_note: Mark Ernestus playing a 3-hour set in LA is not a normal occurrence — he's the co-inventor of dub techno and almost never tours this way — and pairing him with DjRUM's all-vinyl marathon plus Akanbi b2b The Large's amapiano-leaning closer makes this the single most genuinely rare booking in this batch. Extended sets across the board; worth clearing the whole day for.
enrichment.description: CSW's afternoon-to-3am open-air in DTLA: Basic Channel co-founder Mark Ernestus (3hr), all-vinyl selector DjRUM (4hr), and Akanbi b2b The Large (double set), spanning techno, dub, breaks, dnb and amapiano.

events.title: Dublon [rooftop party]
events.organizers: Orlove by Night + All Day All Night + Safra
events.detail: dublon returns to L.A.

artist_notes.name: Dublon
artist_notes.note: Oslo producer/DJ who went viral on TikTok with jazz-inflected house ('Summer in Marseile,' 'belle') — his 'Nectar' EP features jazz saxophonist Nathan Haines; real touring history across European clubs (London's Jazz Café) despite the social-media breakout.

artist_notes.name: Xica Soul
artist_notes.note: LA DJ and radio host (Artform, KQBH) — soul, funk and house, an In Sheep's Clothing-circuit selector.

enrichment.curator_note: TikTok-viral is a red flag on paper, but the jazz-house sound is legit and a 5pm rooftop slot at Harbor House is the right room for it — closer to a sunset groove set than a hype booking.
enrichment.description: 5pm sunset rooftop party at Harbor House DTLA headlined by Oslo jazz-house producer Dublon.

artist_notes.name: Kyle Watson
artist_notes.note: Johannesburg-raised, now-touring tech-house producer — co-owner of the bass-leaning Box of Cats label, with festival slots at Ultra, EDC and Lollapalooza. Jacking, peak-time tech-house rather than a deep/vinyl selector.

enrichment.curator_note: Kyle Watson is a legitimate mainstream tech-house name with real Ultra/EDC pedigree — this is the big-room, festival-adjacent end of the lane rather than a discovery, but it's a genuine headliner at Exchange's scale of room.
enrichment.description: Tech-house/funky-house residency night '360' with Kyle Watson at Exchange LA, DTLA (10pm-3am, $15).

artist_notes.name: LUKAS & FRANK
artist_notes.note: German-Austrian duo who paired up in late 2024 — Lukas plays live saxophone, Frank live cello, layered over Afro/melodic/organic house selections; a fast-growing 'Sax & Cello' mix series has built them real momentum in under two years.

enrichment.curator_note: This is a live-instrument-over-DJ-set format — sax and cello woven into Afro/melodic house — a nice change of pace even if the duo is still a rising name rather than an established headliner.
enrichment.description: German-Austrian duo LUKAS & FRANK bring live saxophone and cello over Afro/melodic house selections to Los Globos in Silver Lake (9pm-2am).

artist_notes.name: The Killing Floors
artist_notes.note: LA five-piece rock 'n' roll band built on 60s garage and punk influences — Music Connection named them one of the Top 100 Live Performers.

artist_notes.name: The Street Walkin' Cheetahs
artist_notes.note: Veteran LA punk/hard-rock band (named for the Stooges' "Search and Destroy"), fronted by Frank Meyer, with members who've shared stages with Radio Birdman's Deniz Tek, MC5's Wayne Kramer, and the New York Dolls' Sylvain Sylvain — real proto-punk lineage, not a tribute act.

enrichment.curator_note: A legitimately stacked garage-punk bill for ten bucks — the Streetwalkin' Cheetahs carry real Stooges/MC5-adjacent pedigree, and the Killing Floors are a real Top 100 live act in their own right.
enrichment.description: Garage-punk and rock 'n' roll triple bill — The Killing Floors, The Street Walkin' Cheetahs, and The Strains — at Permanent Records Roadhouse.

Harder and more rave than groove; adjacent to the hard-techno lane this taste generally steers around, not the fabric/Innervisions end.

events.title: In Between: Roman Flugel & Josh Caffe, Jane Margarette

artist_notes.name: Roman Flügel
artist_notes.note: Veteran German house/techno producer (Ongaku Musik; "Ganz", "Roman IV") and half of 90s duo Alter Ego — a Live at Robert Johnson/Playhouse-lineage DJ, genuine European club royalty and exactly the fabric/Robert Johnson pedigree this lane is built for.

artist_notes.name: Josh Caffé
artist_notes.note: London DJ/producer/vocalist, fabric's Love Child resident and frontman of house-techno duo Paranoid London — released his debut album 'Poppa Zesque' on Erol Alkan's Phantasy label. A real European club booking with a queer-club, vocal-forward edge.

artist_notes.name: Jane Margarette
artist_notes.note: LA DJ playing house/techno around town with residencies at spots like Better Tomorrow and Psstudio — local support, nothing more substantial to verify.

enrichment.curator_note: Roman Flügel is legitimate Robert Johnson-lineage house/techno, and Josh Caffé's fabric pedigree (Paranoid London, Love Child) makes this one of the better-booked In Between nights on the calendar, not just another DTLA warehouse listing.
enrichment.description: In Between hosts German house/techno veteran Roman Flügel and London's Josh Caffé, with support from Jane Margarette, at a TBA DTLA venue, 9pm-4am.

events.title: WA$TED x TRINITY:  HHUNTER @ 1720 Warehouse [18+]

artist_notes.name: Ben UFO

events.title: [CANCELLED] Marques Wyatt B2B Doc Martin - Imagine Luv presents: A Celebration of House Music
events.genre: deep house, tech house, progressive house
reasons: +4 event card (+2 draw, +1 rare booking, +1 stacked bill)

artist_notes.name: Marques Wyatt
artist_notes.note: West Coast deep house legend — ran LA's long-running Deep party/residency from the late '90s into the 2010s and is generally credited with helping put LA's dance scene on the map alongside NYC and Miami.

artist_notes.name: Doc Martin
artist_notes.note: West Coast house pioneer — moved SF to LA in the early '90s, founded the long-running Sublevel label/party (25 years deep in 2026); deep, tribal, acid-inflected house from a genuine scene elder.

artist_notes.name: David Harness
artist_notes.note: Bay Area deep-house DJ/producer/remixer (credits with Mary J. Blige, Alicia Keys) — soulful, classic house across Coachella, Glastonbury and beyond.

artist_notes.name: Big Cee
artist_notes.note: Chris Legaspi — the longtime resident opening DJ at Marques Wyatt's DEEP, a foundational figure in LA's house community who's shared decks with Frankie Knuckles and Louie Vega.

artist_notes.name: SEEPS
artist_notes.note: Bronx-born, LA-based DJ steeped in NYC's '90s golden-era house and disco/boogie — has drawn attention from Louie Vega and DJ Sneak.

enrichment.curator_note: Marques Wyatt and Doc Martin are the two guys most responsible for LA having a real deep-house scene in the first place, and a b2b between them at an open-air DTLA plaza with Big Cee and SEEPS behind them is about as authentic as this town's house lineage gets.
enrichment.description: Outdoor day party (1pm-9pm) at California Plaza with LA deep-house legends Marques Wyatt b2b Doc Martin, plus David Harness, Big Cee and SEEPS.

artist_notes.name: Anfisa Letyago
artist_notes.note: Naples-scene-turned-global techno DJ/producer (Russian-born, Italy-based) — hypnotic, groove-driven techno/house; Moby tapped her for a 2022 'Go' remix, and she runs her own label N:S:DA.

enrichment.curator_note: A real international techno headliner landing in a proper DTLA room on her own night, not sharing a festival stage — worth the Saturday if you're in a techno mood.
enrichment.description: Solo headline techno set from Italy-based DJ/producer Anfisa Letyago at Exchange LA.

events.title: Palm Tree Music Festival - Montecito 2026: Chainsmokers, Kygo, T-Pain, Zedd, All America Rejects, Loud Luxury, Frank Walker, Myles O'Neal, Natalie Jinju
events.venue: Santa Barbara Polo & Racquet Club (Santa Barbara)
events.genre: pop EDM, hip-hop, house, live band, big room

artist_notes.name: Frank Walker
artist_notes.note: Toronto progressive-house/EDM producer signed to Kygo's Palm Tree Records — melodic, vocal-driven big-room tracks (500M+ streams).

artist_notes.name: Loud Luxury
artist_notes.note: Canadian bass-house duo behind the global hit 'Body' — festival-scale, radio-friendly dance-pop.

enrichment.curator_note: Kygo, Chainsmokers, Zedd and T-Pain is a genuinely major bill (Zedd's a tracked name), but this is a $429+ trip to Montecito for a fest that plays a lot more pop-radio than club — worth it only if the day-trip itself is the appeal, not the DJing.
enrichment.description: Two-day Santa Barbara/Montecito pop-EDM festival headlined by The Chainsmokers, Kygo, T-Pain and Zedd, with All American Rejects, Loud Luxury, Frank Walker, Myles O'Neal and Natalie Jinju.

artist_notes.name: Lens
artist_notes.note: Brighton drum & bass DJ-producer, Hospital Records mainstay and host of their Rinse FM show — known for dynamic double-drops and eclectic selection; released on Spearhead too.

enrichment.curator_note: Lens has become one of Hospital Records' go-to voices — a genuinely dynamic double-drop DnB set if that's a lane you want to step into for a night at 1720.
enrichment.description: UK drum & bass DJ/producer Lens (Hospital Records, Rinse FM) plays 1720 in the Arts District, 9pm-2am.

artist_notes.name: Aaron Paar
artist_notes.note: LA scene veteran since the early '90s (fka DJ Destroyer) — Worldship Music/Umoja Hi-Fi affiliate with a long-running Dublab radio show, deep across soul, disco and vintage house.

artist_notes.name: Darone Sassounian
artist_notes.note: LA DJ/producer and Rocky Hill label boss — monthly Club Tee Gee residency since 2019, Dublab radio residency, releases on Habibi Funk and Terrestrial Funk; disco, soul, jazz and vintage-house digging (not the h.wood nightlife exec of the same name).

artist_notes.name: SEEPS
artist_notes.note: Bronx-born, LA-based DJ steeped in NYC's '90s golden-era house and disco/boogie — has drawn attention from Louie Vega and DJ Sneak.

enrichment.curator_note: Three legitimate deep-house/disco diggers for an $11 door — Aaron Paar's been doing this since the early '90s, Darone Sassounian's Rocky Hill label is genuinely good crate-digging, and SEEPS has real NYC pedigree. Punches way above the price.
enrichment.description: Funky-house and nu-disco set from LA diggers Aaron Paar, Darone Sassounian, and SEEPS at The Airliner, Lincoln Heights (9pm-2am, $11).

events.title: Stereo Punks presents GEE LEE & JACK MARLOW

artist_notes.name: Jack Marlow
artist_notes.note: Liverpool-bred UK garage prodigy in his early twenties, drawing on Sammy Virji and Kettama's house-meets-garage sound — already played Boomtown, Night Tales and Pamela in Paris; one of the names actually pushing current UK garage forward.

artist_notes.name: Gee Lee
artist_notes.note: House DJ/producer blending live instrumentation into Boiler-Room-style sets, touring basement clubs in Berlin and Paris through festivals in Australia and Mexico.

enrichment.curator_note: Jack Marlow is genuinely one of the more talked-about names in the current UK garage revival — worth catching this TBA DTLA date before he's playing rooms you can't just walk into.
enrichment.description: House and UK garage set from rising UK DJ Jack Marlow and Gee Lee at a TBA DTLA venue (8pm-2am, $23-34.50).

events.title: Sirens X Dx3: Man Power, SONNS & Tavish, Capes, D'ETE

artist_notes.name: Man Power
artist_notes.note: UK DJ/producer (Geoff Kirkwood, Newcastle) and boss of the Me Me Me label — genuinely eclectic cosmic disco, dub techno and throwback piano house; a characterful, Balearic-leaning booking rather than a generic tech-house name.

artist_notes.name: SONNS
artist_notes.note: LA underground fixture (Alexandre Mouracade), founder of Making Shapes and the In Between and DISCOS XXX party series, releases on his own Machine Limited label plus Kompakt and ESP Institute — a punk-rooted, synth-into-house selector who's a real name in this scene.

artist_notes.name: Tavish
artist_notes.note: Venice-native LA warehouse-scene DJ (also a Grammy-winning producer as half of Sid Roams) — industrial disco and acid house; a fixture across the city's underground circuit.

artist_notes.name: Capes
artist_notes.note: LA DJ/producer/promoter, one half of Club Tularosa — a regular supporting name on the local underground/DIY circuit.

enrichment.curator_note: Man Power's unpredictable cosmic-disco sets paired with SONNS' actual LA pedigree (Making Shapes, Kompakt releases) make this the most substantial all-night booking of the DTLA afters crop this week.
enrichment.description: Sirens x Dx3 afters (TBA DTLA, 10pm-5am) with UK's Man Power, LA's SONNS and Tavish, Capes and D'ETE.

artist_notes.note: Vancouver-based hard-techno/hardstyle producer-vocalist ('The Green Machine') — releases on Scantraxx and Barong Family, has played EDC Las Vegas; real cred within that scene.

enrichment.curator_note: Angel Cannon's legit within hard techno/hardstyle circles — EDC Vegas credits, Scantraxx and Barong Family releases — but hard dance is the one lane this taste steers away from outright, so this is a pass unless that's specifically the night you're after.
enrichment.description: Late-night hard-techno/hardstyle warehouse party headlined by Angel Cannon, with Rio Sky, Ariana Sanjuan, Assidious and Akane, 11:45pm–5am.

artist_notes.note: Berlin-based producer working what he calls 'Italo Body Music' — Italo disco slammed into EBM, synthwave and industrial. Own label Second Sight, a Berghain/Panorama Bar regular, viral 2023 Boiler Room set at Khidi.

enrichment.curator_note: Pablo Bozzi's Italo-disco-into-EBM sound is a genuinely distinct thing out of Berlin (real Boiler Room/Panorama Bar pedigree), worth catching in an intimate DTLA room even without a read on his co-bill partner Jorkes.

events.title: Bonnie Raitt: Live 2026 with Special Guest Jon Cleary
lineup: Jon Cleary & the Absolute Monster Gentlemen
events.detail: Bluesy singer/songwriter Bonnie Raitt has worked long and hard for her multiple Grammy Awards, hit singles and chart-topping records. Since her 1971 eponymous debut, the California-born performer and long-time activist has steadily maintained a music career, albeit with definite peaks and valleys. The red-headed songstress, one of the only women of her time to play guitar using the bottleneck technique, unleashed seven albums in just nine years, though her big commercial break came with her 10th studio set, 1989’s “Nick of Time.” That 11-track collection, produced by Don Was, earned three Grammy Awards, including Album of the Year. Not only has the Rock and Roll Hall of Famer tackled multiple U.S. tours and international runs, but she’s also a frequent participant in events of social activism, such as Farm Aid and Amnesty International concerts. Raitt’s 16th full-length album and most recent studio release, “Slipstream,” hit retailers in 2012. Not only did ticket sales for the support tour soar, but Raitt also landed the best-selling blues album of the year and took home the Grammy for Best Americana Album.

events.title: SYNTHESIS 002: Anastasia Giovani, Blazej Malinowski, Kameliia & Secus
reasons: +3 event card (+1 draw, +1 rare booking, +1 stacked bill)

sounds_like: hypnotic, dense techno in the Inner Tension/SXTCY mold

artist_notes.name: Anastasia Giovani
artist_notes.note: LA underground techno regular — SXTCY resident known for dark, raw, propulsive sets; also runs VSCRL, a modular/vinyl/noise-leaning event series.

artist_notes.name: Blazej Malinowski
artist_notes.note: Polish, Berlin-based techno producer — founder of the Inner Tension label, deep and hypnotic productions on Semantica and Silent Season.

artist_notes.name: Kameliia
artist_notes.note: Oslo-based techno DJ (Bulgarian-born) — self-described 'mental techno,' driving and atmospheric, releases on Token and SK_eleven; has played Berghain, Fold and Berlin Atonal.

artist_notes.name: Secus
artist_notes.note: LA techno producer (Matt Salamone) — half of Motionen, co-founder of label Ascetic Limited; jazz/metal-informed, hard and agitated techno.

enrichment.curator_note: A legit deep-techno afterhours booking — Berlin's Blazej Malinowski and Oslo's Kameliia flying in alongside LA's own Anastasia Giovani and Secus for a 5am TBA start. Hypnotic, dense end of the spectrum, not big-room — worth it only if you're actually built for a real after-hours.
enrichment.description: TBA-location LA techno afterhours (5am start) — SYNTHESIS's second edition pairs Berlin's Blazej Malinowski and Oslo's Kameliia with LA regulars Anastasia Giovani and Secus.

events.title: Solitary Gardens: Final Communion Rave - Sub Imperium

artist_notes.name: Sub Imperium
artist_notes.note: Producer on Occult Rhythms and Askorn Records — labels built around hard, dark, EBM-tinged techno; rougher and more industrial than the refined European techno lane.

enrichment.curator_note: Sub Imperium is a real name in the dark/industrial-techno underground, and the 'Final Communion' framing suggests this could be closing out the Solitary Gardens series — worth noting even though the genre (EBM/industrial) sits a notch harder than the usual pick.

An innate knack for pinball catapults him from reticent adolescent to celebrity savior. Tony Award-winning composer Pete Townshend and Tony Award-winning original director Des McAnuff find powerful resonance reexamining this classic story for today.

artist_notes.name: Mesmé
artist_notes.note: LA DJ/producer (debut EP on Mall Grab's Steel City Dance Discs) — vinyl-heavy blends of moody acid, electro, house and trip-hop; Into the Woods and Dublab resident, Boiler Room 2021.

enrichment.curator_note: Onur Özer's Cocoon/Ibiza pedigree plus Mayell (who's literally shared stages with him) makes this Halloween booking sharper than the usual TBA-warehouse techno night — add Mesmé's vinyl-digger set and it's a genuinely stacked bill if the location comes together.
enrichment.description: Halloween club night with Cocoon-circuit techno DJ Onur Özer, Slovenian house selector Mayell, LA's Mesmé, Pete Jonas, Rocky and Jackson Algeo at a TBA LA location, 11pm–6am.

enrichment.curator_note: ANOTR is a legit big-room tech-house draw right now, and Factory 93 putting it under the 6th Street Bridge is a real venue flex — this is the mainstream-headliner-that-still-counts lane, not filler.
enrichment.description: Factory 93 hosts Dutch tech-house duo ANOTR (No Art) at Ace/Mission Studios under the 6th Street Bridge in DTLA.

artist_notes.name: Richie Hawtin
artist_notes.note: Windsor/Detroit-Berlin minimal-techno icon (Plastikman, F.U.S.E.; founder of Plus 8 and M_nus) — a defining name in stripped, hypnotic techno.

artist_notes.name: Cloonee
artist_notes.note: Manchester-raised tech-house producer Dave Bissett (CLNE, Repopulate Mars, Sola) — Beatport #1s including 'Like What' and a Chris Lake collab 'Nightmares'; one of the circuit's best crowd-movers.

artist_notes.name: DJ Tennis
artist_notes.note: Manfredi Romano — Italian scene godfather who founded Life and Death in 2010 (Tale Of Us, Mind Against and Carlita all came up through the label); a globally touring, melodic house/techno selector.

artist_notes.name: Adam Ten
artist_notes.note: Israeli-born, Amsterdam-based producer — half of Adam Ten & Mita Gami, the melodic house/techno duo who took over Coachella's Yuma Tent two weekends running in 2024; co-founder of the Maccabi House movement.

artist_notes.name: Avalon Emerson
artist_notes.note: American techno/house DJ-producer (SF by way of Berlin) — melodic, songwriterly club techno (the Whities-era singles, her '&More' LP); a genuine global-circuit headliner.

artist_notes.name: Kana Hishiya
artist_notes.note: Japan-born, LA-based DJ/producer — house and techno moving between punchy, minimal and broken-beat, with dreamy melodic turns; played MEOKO and Sirens LA podcast series.

artist_notes.name: Maddix
artist_notes.note: Dutch producer known for a hard-hitting techno/big-room/trance crossover (breakout track 'Ecstasy'), Revealed Recordings-affiliated. Mainstage-built and harder-edged than the refined techno end of the lane (Charlotte de Witte, Amelie Lens) — closer to festival trance-techno.

enrichment.curator_note: Insomniac's Halloween mega-fest buries real house/techno headliners — Hawtin, Kraviz, Capriati, DJ Tennis, Jamie Jones — under a dozen stages of hardstyle, dubstep, and bass. Worth it for a specific set, not for the vibe of the thing as a whole.
enrichment.description: Insomniac's Halloween festival at NOS Events Center in San Bernardino, spanning house/techno headliners (Richie Hawtin, Nina Kraviz, Joseph Capriati) alongside trance, dubstep, and hardstyle stages.

enrichment.curator_note: No lineup posted yet for this Halloween-week booking — 1720 is a dependable warehouse-techno room, but hard to rate blind at $46.

events.title: Lights Down Low: Rave To The Grave -Avalon Emerson, Sextile (DJ Set), Ellen Allien, Effy, Johnny_Health, Richie Panic, Corey Sizemore
reasons: +4 event card (+2 draw, +1 rare booking, +1 stacked bill)

artist_notes.name: Avalon Emerson
artist_notes.note: American techno/house DJ-producer (SF by way of Berlin) — melodic, songwriterly club techno (the Whities-era singles, her '&More' LP); a genuine global-circuit headliner.

artist_notes.name: Sextile
artist_notes.note: LA synth-punk/EBM band (Sacred Bones) that's leaned harder into techno and rave sounds on its newest record — gothy, driving, club-adjacent post-punk; DJ set here rather than live.

artist_notes.name: Ellen Allien
artist_notes.note: Berlin techno pioneer and BPitch Control label founder since the '90s — raw, physical, art-damaged techno; about as European-scene as a booking gets.

artist_notes.name: Effy
artist_notes.note: UK (Blackpool/London) DJ-producer doing druggy acid techno and classic-house revivalism — has opened for Helena Hauff, Scuba, Honey Dijon and Peggy Gou.

artist_notes.name: Johnny_Health
artist_notes.note: LA underground rave-circuit DJ (Hood Rave/Hellraiser-type parties) — thin bio beyond a busy local DJ résumé.

artist_notes.name: Richie Panic
artist_notes.note: Founder of Lights Down Low (also Frisco Disco, Blow Up) — the LA promoter behind this exact series, known for genre-blurring 'weird' house and techno bills.

artist_notes.name: Corey Sizemore
artist_notes.note: LA/SF DJ, co-founder and resident of Lights Down Low alongside Richie Panic; eclectic house-and-techno sets, Boiler Room alum.

enrichment.curator_note: Ellen Allien and Avalon Emerson on the same Halloween bill is a real techno booking, not a costume-party gimmick — and Lights Down Low's own crew (Richie Panic, Corey Sizemore) plus Sextile's DJ set keep it weird instead of trick-or-treat cute.
enrichment.description: Lights Down Low's Halloween all-nighter (TBA location, 9pm-4am) stacks Berlin techno legend Ellen Allien and Avalon Emerson with Sextile's DJ set and the LDL residents.

enrichment.curator_note: Certified Groovers usually books real deep-house names (DJ Sneak, Mark Farina, Doc Martin, Chez Damier have all played the series) — no lineup posted yet for this Halloween edition, but the promoter's track record makes it worth watching for an announcement.
enrichment.description: Certified Groovers' Halloween Party at a TBA Downtown LA location — no lineup announced yet (10pm, Oct 31).

artist_notes.name: Brijean
artist_notes.note: Oakland duo (Brijean Murphy & Doug Stuart) on Ghostly International — Murphy is also the touring percussionist for Poolside and Toro y Moi; their own sound is warm, congas-driven boogie/dream-pop. This is a DJ set, not the live band, so expect disco/house selections in that same breezy register.

enrichment.curator_note: Brijean behind the decks rather than behind the congas is a nice change of format — her Ghostly/Poolside pedigree suggests a warm, disco-leaning selection for a Halloween night at Camille's.
enrichment.description: Halloween DJ set (disco/house/pop) from Ghostly International duo Brijean at The Bellwether's Camille's night.

artist_notes.name: Giegling
artist_notes.note: The Weimar, Germany label/collective (Traumprinz aka DJ Metatron, Konstantin/Kettenkarussell, Vril, HVL and others) behind some of the most mythologized, hypnotic house and techno of the last decade — genuinely rare to see a Giegling-branded date in LA, though the listing doesn't say which member of the crew is actually playing.

enrichment.curator_note: A Giegling booking in LA is unusual enough to flag even without knowing which artist from the crew is actually behind the decks — TBA location and a 6am run time both point to the real afterhours version of this, from the same Midnight Lovers crew as Masha Mar's other nights.

events.title: OBSERVE 24 YEAR ANNIVERSARY // Chris Liebing [5hr Set] // Truncate // OKTAFORM (Visuals)

sounds_like: Cell Injection's raw, stripped-down techno lineage

artist_notes.name: Chris Liebing
artist_notes.note: German techno veteran since the early-'90s Frankfurt scene, founder of the purist techno label/podcast CLR — a genuine headline-tier name (Awakenings, Time Warp) known for dark, driving, relentless sets; a 5-hour set is a real event, not a normal tour-stop hour.

artist_notes.name: Truncate
artist_notes.note: David Flores — LA producer and co-founder of OBSERVE (with Moe Espinosa/Drumcell); raw, hypnotic, groove-driven techno that's played Berghain, fabric, Concrete and Awakenings. This is his own party's anniversary, not a guest slot.

artist_notes.name: OKTAFORM
artist_notes.note: Recurring visual artist for OBSERVE's parties (also did visuals for their 2024 Speedy J/Drumcell edition) — no separate DJ/production profile found.

enrichment.curator_note: OBSERVE has quietly been one of LA's most credible techno institutions for 24 years now — Truncate co-founded it, and getting Chris Liebing to play a 5-hour set for the anniversary instead of a standard hour is exactly the kind of immersive booking worth planning a warehouse night around.
enrichment.description: 24th-anniversary edition of OBSERVE, the long-running LA techno party co-founded by Truncate, at a TBA DTLA location — a 5-hour Chris Liebing headline set with Truncate and OKTAFORM visuals, 11pm start.

events.title: Midnight Lovers Invites Dekmantel Soundsystem & Make A Dance
Sneak's Birthday Beats 2026: Derrick Carter, DJ Sneak, DJ Heather, H-Foundation, Hector Moralez, J-Dub, Juliet Mendoza, Masha Mar, Ian Llorens, Stacy Christine, Tom Carle, Your Unkle Magik
events.genre: funky house, jackin house, deep house, tech house

artist_notes.name: Mark Farina
artist_notes.note: Chicago-born, SF-based house legend behind the long-running 'Mushroom Jazz' series — a jazzy, downtempo-inflected strain of house he's been refining since the mid-90s.

artist_notes.name: Josh Wink
artist_notes.note: Philadelphia techno/house legend ('Higher State of Consciousness') and Ovum Recordings co-founder since 1994 — still a headline-level booking three decades in.

artist_notes.name: DJ Dazy
artist_notes.note: LA house DJ since 1992 — founded the all-female Sister DJs collective, deep and soulful vinyl-rooted sets, part of the West Coast house lineage this bill leans on.

artist_notes.name: Your Unkle Magik
artist_notes.note: Vinyl-only house selector, a regular on the Certified Groovers/DTLA open-air circuit.

artist_notes.name: Tom Carle
artist_notes.note: LA underground DJ working deep/minimal tech-house and techno — longtime host of a DJ podcast since 2018, regular alongside DJ Sneak and J-Dub on the CHI♡LA circuit.

artist_notes.name: Derrick Carter
artist_notes.note: Chicago house legend since the late-'80s Warehouse/Muzic Box lineage — co-runs Classic Music Company with Luke Solomon; funky, genre-agnostic, unmistakable house selection still headlining at this level.

artist_notes.name: Doc Martin
artist_notes.note: West Coast house pioneer — moved SF to LA in the early '90s, founded the long-running Sublevel label/party (25 years deep in 2026); deep, tribal, acid-inflected house from a genuine scene elder.

artist_notes.name: DJ Heather
artist_notes.note: Chicago house DJ, co-founder of the pioneering all-female Superjane crew (with DJ Colette, Dayhota, Lady D) — soulful, genre-blurring sets rooted in Gramaphone Records digging.

artist_notes.name: John Tejada
artist_notes.note: Vienna-born, LA-based since childhood — Palette Recordings founder and a fixture of musical, melodic techno/deep house since the mid-90s (Kompakt, Pokerflat, Cocoon). Real underground pedigree headlining his own night.

artist_notes.name: DJ Sneak
artist_notes.note: Chicago house OG ('the Turntable Terrorist') — jacking, sample-heavy garage-house going back to the early-'90s Cajmere/Relief era, still DJing at that level today.

artist_notes.name: H-Foundation
artist_notes.note: San Diego duo (Hipp-E & Halo) — dub-inflected deep/tech-house with a Fabric London residency and a Chemical Brothers remix credit to their name; not a frequent LA booking.

artist_notes.name: Heidi Lawden
artist_notes.note: LA-via-London selector who cut her teeth in the '90s UK queer rave scene — house/techno/disco marathon sets (an 8-hour solo warehouse set till 8am) and a longtime DJ Harvey tour collaborator/muse. Also on the Defected boardwalk afterparty this batch.

artist_notes.name: Masha Mar
artist_notes.note: Serbian-born, LA-based DJ/curator (the Midnight Lovers crew) with NTS and Dublab residencies — Italo disco, house and dancefloor edits.

artist_notes.name: Hector Moralez
artist_notes.note: Oakland-raised, now LA-based house DJ/producer (Minority Music, The Factory labels) — Chicago/Detroit-rooted, soul-deep selections; a regular in Sneak's LA circle.

artist_notes.name: Juliet Mendoza
artist_notes.note: LA-native house DJ and dancer — founder/resident of Jill's House (Jackin Jills), a Defected 'Unsung Heroes' alum; melodic, soulful, deep house rooted in the city's Black/Latin house dance lineage.

artist_notes.name: Dj Kerry
artist_notes.note: LA DJ since 2005, longtime Dublab radio host and founder of The Basement, a membership-based party rooted in Paradise Garage/West Coast warehouse tradition.

artist_notes.name: Stacy Christine
artist_notes.note: LA warehouse-scene DJ since 2012 (Music For Dancers, Critter Control, Machine Club lineage) — joyful house into kinetic techno; has opened for DJ Harvey, Moodymann, and Honey Dijon.

artist_notes.name: J-Dub
artist_notes.note: Chicago-bred new-school house DJ and frequent DJ Sneak collaborator on the LA circuit (CHI♡LA, Certified Groovers) — funky, percussive, seamless-blend style.

artist_notes.name: Ian Llorens
artist_notes.note: Certified Groovers resident, LA-based (Puerto Rico-born) — rhythm-forward house/techno selector, also plays as O God / Soundprism.

enrichment.curator_note: A three-day house marathon built around DJ Sneak's birthday with Derrick Carter, Mark Farina and Josh Wink on the bill — this is Chicago-house royalty depth you don't see stacked this thick very often, TBA location aside.
enrichment.description: Multi-day (Sat 4pm–Mon 2am) house celebration for DJ Sneak's birthday, TBA location, with Derrick Carter, Mark Farina, Josh Wink, DJ Heather, John Tejada and a deep bench of Chicago-rooted house DJs.

artist_notes.name: Ferry Corsten
artist_notes.note: Dutch trance OG since the late-90s boom (System F, Gouryella with a young Tiësto) who now runs his own Flashover label and plays a broader, more contemporary progressive-leaning set.

artist_notes.name: Artbat
artist_notes.note: Ukrainian duo (Artur Kryvenko & Vitalii Limarenko) — melodic techno breakout via Solomun's Diynamic label ('Upperground', 'Atlas'); one of the names most responsible for melodic techno's mainstream crossover.

artist_notes.name: Enrico Sangiuliano
artist_notes.note: Italian techno producer, one of Drumcode's biggest-selling artists for a stretch (Adam Beyer's label) — hypnotic, sci-fi-tinged peak-time techno built for big rooms.

artist_notes.name: BT
artist_notes.note: Brian Transeau — one of American trance's founding names since the late-90s, still touring a big, cinematic, melody-forward sound.

artist_notes.name: Hannah Laing
artist_notes.note: Scottish DJ/producer on the UK hard-house/hardcore-revival wave — high-BPM, rave-nostalgic tech house.

artist_notes.name: Pegassi
artist_notes.note: Belgian producer (Sam Huybrecht) running his own label/party series Sweet Nothing — a deliberately 'post-genre' set that swings between trance, techno, eurodance and house rather than staying in a lane. Closer to a big-room selector than a groove/disco DJ.

enrichment.curator_note: Trance is mostly outside the lane, but this is the genre's biggest annual SoCal gathering, and Artbat and Enrico Sangiuliano's melodic-techno sets are a real reason to go beyond nostalgia for Above & Beyond and Ferry Corsten.
enrichment.description: Insomniac's SoCal trance festival, headlined by Above & Beyond and Ferry Corsten with melodic-techno crossover sets from Artbat and Enrico Sangiuliano.

events.title: Countdown NYE 2026
reasons: +4 event card (+3 draw, +1 rare booking, +1 stacked bill)

artist_notes.name: Seven Lions
artist_notes.note: Jeff Montalvo — melodic dubstep/bass pioneer and Ophelia Records founder; the genre-defining name pulling this bill outside the house/techno lane.

artist_notes.name: TOKiMONSTA
artist_notes.note: LA producer (Jennifer Lee) — Grammy-nominated future-beat/bass artist and one of the first women to headline a Coachella mainstage set; genre-blending rather than straight house/techno.

artist_notes.name: Tchami
artist_notes.note: French DJ/producer who coined 'future house' and runs the Confession label/party brand — the more house-leaning name on an otherwise bass-heavy bill.

artist_notes.name: Oliver Heldens
artist_notes.note: Dutch producer — broke out with 2014's 'Gecko,' a future-house pioneer alongside Tchami; also runs a deeper techno alias, HI-LO.

artist_notes.name: Gordo
artist_notes.note: Formerly Carnage — the trap/EDM producer rebranded into house a few years back and now runs with the Solid Grooves crowd; a genuine lane-shift, not just a rename.

artist_notes.name: Flosstradamus
artist_notes.note: Chicago duo (Curt Cameruci, Josh Young) — one of the acts that built festival trap in the early 2010s, still a heavy bass-stage draw.

artist_notes.name: Mija
artist_notes.note: LA bass/house DJ-producer in the Brownies & Lemonade orbit — eclectic, genre-hopping sets that land more bass-forward than house.

artist_notes.name: R3hab
artist_notes.note: Dutch big-room/progressive house DJ-producer (Cyb3rpvnk) — festival-mainstage staple for over a decade.

artist_notes.name: Archie Hamilton
artist_notes.note: London DJ/producer/label owner — an early architect of a rugged, atmospheric minimal-house-and-techno sound; MicroHertz label boss and a Paradise Ibiza regular.

artist_notes.name: James Hype
artist_notes.note: UK tech-house/bass-house DJ-producer — viral 'Ferrari' remix and a PIRATE Copenhagen resident; crossed from underground tech-house into a full mainstage festival draw.

artist_notes.name: Ranger Trucco
artist_notes.note: Michigan-born tech-house producer/vocalist, Space Yacht signee — clean, warbling tech-house with his own sung hooks.

artist_notes.name: TOBEHONEST
artist_notes.note: LA-based tech-house DJ/producer on the come-up — Latin-groove/hip-hop-inflected sound with Beatport Top 100 releases and cosigns from Chris Lake and John Summit.

artist_notes.name: TroyBoi
artist_notes.note: UK bass/trap producer known for a distinctive chopped-vocal sound — a big mainstage draw in the bass-music world, outside the house/techno lane.

artist_notes.name: Walker & Royce
artist_notes.note: LA house/tech-house duo — Dirtybird-adjacent, quirky vocal-driven house cuts; a home-turf name on this bill.

enrichment.curator_note: Insomniac's flagship NYE blowout at NOS — DJ Snake, Alesso and Marshmello are real headliners, and there's a genuine house/tech-house thread running through Gordo, Walker & Royce and TOBEHONEST, but most of this 30-deep bill is bass/trap/dubstep mainstage stuff, not a selector's set. Go for the production and the countdown, not the DJing.
enrichment.description: Insomniac's Countdown NYE 2026 at NOS Event Center — a 30-plus-artist multi-stage lineup headlined by DJ Snake, Alesso and Marshmello, running house through bass/trap into midnight.
